definition: Number of settled, independent betting opportunities the strategy has taken
pass_criteria: N >= N_min(edge, price) computed in scripts/stats.py; default N_min for a 3% edge at -110 with 95% confidence and 80% power
fail_action: no money; strategy stays in paper tier
why_this_removes_luck: A small sample cannot distinguish 54% from 46%; the gate makes that arithmetic explicit instead of rhetorical

definition: Every parameter is estimated on data strictly before the bet timestamp; no in-sample evaluation
pass_criteria: 100% of evaluation folds are out-of-time; parameter freeze hash recorded before kickoff
why_this_removes_luck: Look-ahead is the #1 source of fake edges in sports models
current_state: specified; not yet enforced by CI

definition: Mean (model price - closing price) and the share of bets taken better than the close
pass_criteria: mean CLV > 0 with a CI that excludes 0; beat-the-close rate > 50% with CI excluding 50%
why_this_removes_luck: CLV converges ~10x faster than ROI and is immune to who won the game; it is the luck-free score of a pricing model

definition: Every candidate signal in the catalogue is tested in the same family and corrected
pass_criteria: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR <= 0.10 across the catalogue; top-of-leaderboard rows also pass a Deflated Sharpe at n_trials = catalogue size
why_this_removes_luck: A 40-signal zoo will produce 2 'significant' signals from pure noise at p<0.05; without the correction the leaderboard rewards the luckiest backtest
data_required: all strategies on the same evaluation window

definition: Edge must survive dropping the most favourable games and the most favourable weeks
pass_criteria: recomputing with the top 5% winning bets removed keeps ROI > 0; leaving out any single season keeps ROI > 0
fail_action: investigate concentration; usually the edge is one quarter of one season
why_this_removes_luck: One blowout week can carry a whole 'system'

definition: Model must be evaluated at executable prices with real limits
pass_criteria: spread/total at -110 or the actual book price; props at -120; parlay priced at the offered combined odds; stake <= book limit; no fill if line moved past our number
fail_action: re-price at realistic cost; most 'edges' die here
why_this_removes_luck: Vig is the deterministic part of the loss; ignoring it converts a break-even model into a winning one

definition: Portfolio variance must use the covariance of the legs, not independence
pass_criteria: covariance-adjusted variance and drawdown within the owner's stated limit (Q-17)
fail_action: reduce stake or split the slate
why_this_removes_luck: A parlay's 'skill' is mostly the correlation it refused to price; treating legs as independent understates variance and hides it

definition: Two signals firing on the same underlying fact must not both consume full stake size
pass_criteria: dedupe key = (game, causal driver); exposure per driver capped
fail_action: merge the legs into one priced position
why_this_removes_luck: Otherwise one injury report line looks like three independent edges; that is correlation counted as two chances to be right

definition: Rolling 8-week prediction quality must not be negative in the majority of windows
pass_criteria: median of rolling log-loss-vs-market <= 0 in >= 70% of windows across >= 3 seasons
why_this_removes_luck: Luck shows up as a smooth 8-week streak; regime stability shows up as consistency across years

definition: Every input row used by a published price must be verification_status=verified or derived-verified
pass_criteria: build fails if any row feeding a price is unverified/blank
fail_action: block the publish (this build already does: see docs/verification.html)
why_this_removes_luck: A model priced on a guessed injury status is not a model

definition: Strategy must be executable at open, at size, on markets we are allowed to use
pass_criteria: fill rate >= 90% of accepted signals; limit utilisation logged
fail_action: reduce signal frequency; prefer slower-moving props
why_this_removes_luck: An edge you cannot place is not an edge; a strategy that gets accounts limited has a half-life that must be priced in

definition: Rankings must be reproducible from an immutable log by anyone
pass_criteria: predictions hashed and timestamped before kickoff; one entry per (strategy, game, market); recompute from ledger matches published board
why_this_removes_luck: The leaderboard is a reward mechanism; if it can be gamed, the reward selects for gaming rather than skill

definition: Report the expected result under the model's own probabilities next to the realised result
pass_criteria: both numbers published every week; a strategy is judged on the gap shrinking over time
fail_action: n/a - this gate only changes what is reported
why_this_removes_luck: This is the direct answer to 'remove luck from the equation': realised ROI = prediction quality + variance in small samples
